finding: Projectless session creation persists a catalog binding, but WorkZ does not consume it. A bound managed directory is rejected by chat_turn and ApprovalHooks because require_binding accepts only TaskEnvironment records, not the projectless catalog.
conclusion_proposal: Keep preparing and do not wire the UI until host-trusted catalog binding is checked at initial turn and every authorization recheck.
next_action: Add trusted projectless binding mode across chat_turn, approval rechecks and task observation; then wire WorkZ new/reopen and test two-session isolation plus lost-catalog recovery.
verification_gaps: No native task routing or recovery journey
